Ancestral Regression.descriptionOnly: its low-light vision in place of darkvision and light blindness, and its undetectable alignment, are told here

Battle Trance.descriptionOnly: its temporary hit points, 1d6 + caster level (+10 at most), its ferocity, the 4 points of Intelligence damage it deals on casting and the DC 20 concentration check to cast are told here

Bestow Insight.descriptionOnly: +2, +1 more for every four caster levels, +6 at most; the target counts as trained in the skill, and its one roll of two checks is told here

Blend.descriptionOnly: only while it moves no more than half its base speed; it may make Stealth checks without cover or concealment

Blessing of Luck and Resolve.descriptionOnly: a target with the fearless racial trait is immune to fear instead; the reroll with a +4 morale bonus that ends it is told here

Blood Scent.descriptionOnly: only for orcs and raging creatures, +4 against a strong scent; its scent for injured creatures is told here

Death from Below.descriptionOnly: no path: its dodge bonus, +1 for each size category the attacker is larger, at most +1 per 3 caster levels (+1 per 2 for a gnome), is judged against each attacker

Fearsome Duplicate.descriptionOnly: the +2 on saves to disbelieve it is that of the creatures who know the caster

Fire Trail.descriptionOnly: no path: its numbers are its damage or healing, DCs and saves against it, rolled at the table

Ghost Wolf.descriptionOnly: no path: the ghost wolf's bite +10 and 1d8+6 damage, and its fear aura, are its own

Gusting Sphere.descriptionOnly: no path: the sphere's –4 on ranged attacks through it, its CMB with +2 for its Strength and its damage are its own

Improve Trap.descriptionOnly: no path: the trap's +1 CR and its +5 DC or +2 on its attack or save are the trap's

Ironbeard.descriptionOnly: an armor bonus that stacks with worn armor, so untyped here (it is no bonus to touch AC); its 20% spell failure for verbal components and its use as armor spikes are told here

Linebreaker.descriptionOnly: its +20 foot bonus to base speed when charging is told here

Marid's Mastery.descriptionOnly: the +1 when it and its opponent both touch water; the –4 when either touches the ground

Nereid's Grace.descriptionOnly: only without armor; its Charisma bonus, +3 at most, +1 more for every 6 levels, +6 at most

Paragon Surge.descriptionOnly: the feat it is treated as having is told here

Sacred Space.descriptionOnly: no path: the +2 DC of good spells and channeled energy and the –1 on evil outsiders' attacks, damage and saves (doubled with an altar) are the area's

Savage Maw.descriptionOnly: no path: its bite, 1d4 + Strength and bleed on a critical hit, a secondary attack at full base attack bonus –5, is told here

Sentry Skull.descriptionOnly: no path: the head's darkvision, low-light vision and +5 on Perception are its own

Shadow Anchor.descriptionOnly: no path: its –1 for every 5 feet from the tether is on the target's check against it, at the table

Stone Shield.descriptionOnly: cover from one opponent; the shield's hardness 8 and 15 hit points are its own

Strong Wings.descriptionOnly: no path: the speeds and maneuverability it names are the form's or the creature's own, as they are at the table. only with wings it flies with; its maneuverability one category better (good at most) is told here

Veil of Heaven.descriptionOnly: its dismissal's 1d8 + paladin level damage is told here

Village Veil.descriptionOnly: no path: its +2 is on the second save of a suspicious creature investigating the area; the creatures with the traits the caster names are immune to it

choices.label: Ward of the Season: the season

Ward of the Season.descriptionOnly: spring's 1 hit point a round below 0, summer's 30 feet for a round, fall's rolls twice against disease and poison and winter's footing are told here

Web Cloud.descriptionOnly: no path: the webbing's fire resistance 5 is its own; it otherwise acts as web on the creatures in the cloud

choices.label: Whispering Lore: the Knowledge of the terrain

Windy Escape.descriptionOnly: no path: against the one attack it answers: DR 10/magic and immunity to that attack's poison, sneak attack and critical hit, at the table

Winter Feathers.descriptionOnly: only with its feathers turned white; comfortable down to –50 degrees Fahrenheit
